content.text:
**Voice message to a friend:**

"OK so, the S&P thing. The page basically says: open the account at **Psagot**, the פסגות ניירות ערך one, and buy the fund called **ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)**. It's at the top in huge numbers: 86,492 ₪ is 'הכי הרבה נשאר בזוג הזה'. That's if you put in 10,000 ₪ now and then 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, so 70,000 ₪ total. That's pretty much me, so I didn't even try to change the amounts. Fund fees show **0.02%**, which is basically nothing.

What actually got me was one bold line: **the account you pick matters way more than the fund.** Up to 22,985 ₪ difference between accounts, but only up to 4,492 ₪ between funds. The worst one on that line was מיטב טרייד at 63,507 ₪. Wow.

I'm fairly sure, not totally. I'd still want someone to tell me it's legit, and I didn't check anything myself.

I scrolled the left list a bit. אלטשולר's S&P fund is only 43 ₪ less. **iShares Core S&P 500**, the one everyone on TikTok talks about, is 213 ₪ less, so that doesn't really matter. On the right side, Leumi comes 2nd and One Zero 3rd. Psagot's account costs **1,057 ₪** over 10 years. Most of that is something called 'דמי משמרת' at 699 ₪, plus 356 ₪ in 'עמלות קנייה ומכירה'. So even the cheapest account isn't free.

Words I didn't get: מחקה (is that an ETF or not?), 4D, צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, מנוטרל מט"ח, 'מס גם על שינויי המטבע', דמי משמרת, 'מחזיקה את המניות', and 'לא בחשבון' next to Leumi. I skipped all the colorful filter chips and the grey paragraph under 'כל החשבונות'.

It's dark and modern, so I didn't swipe away straight off. But the middle has all these lines with tiny tick marks and I had no clue what each mark is, so I just read the numbers. Once I hit the long list of accounts and the walls of chips I'd basically had enough and would close it."

**What I looked at:** The big 86,492 / 70,000 box at the top, then the heading "כמה כל בחירה משנה" and the bold line under it. Then the Psagot account card with its 1,057 ₪, the top of the fund list (Yalin, Altshuler, iShares), and ranks 1–3 in the account list.

**What I skipped:** The tick-mark chart, the filter chips, the grey explanation paragraph, the fold arrow next to Leumi, the "+" button and the "קיבלתם מחיר אחר?" link.

**Where I got stuck:** I couldn't tell if מחקה means it's an ETF. I also couldn't see where to type my own monthly amount. The 70,000 is underlined, but I didn't tap it.
